items.text: Fixed multiple Frankenstein pet bugs: ignoring shields, sinking in terrain, invisible ranged attacks, kicking owners, and moving through windows.
Fixed NPC corpses being unlootable after a server restart.
Fixed scarecrows sometimes not spawning in one of the Halloween dungeon corridors.
Fixed radiation starting immediately upon entering the Halloween and Xmas dungeons.
Added a second CaveNetworkGroupLayerOverride to the nuclear missile silo to stop players and NPCs disappearing/reappearing on stairs.
Added a DungeonGridBlocker to canyon tunnels to prevent underground train tunnels from generating too close and removing terrain collision, reducing accidental deaths at canyon bottoms.
Fixed badly merged animation controllers and livestock FSM, restoring proper animal behavior.
Adjusted tree spawn rates: coconut trees now spawn at 25% chance (previously 100%) and reduced their network range; apple/beehive spawn chance on oak trees increased to 25% (from 15%).
Fixed code lock light quads staying visible at any distance after spawning.
Fixed door controller lights not being culled, preventing them from rendering at unintended distances.
Fixed particle systems (e.g., conveyor flashes, furnace heat shimmers) playing at any distance when enabled, reducing unintended distant visual effects.
Resolved bugs with group change polling, improving reliability of group membership updates.
Added a separate "currently craftable" list and an "All" button, and changed category buttons to a toggle group that switches to the selected category only, improving navigation of craftable items.
Multiple lighthouses now share their resource and repair progress, streamlining maintenance across lighthouse structures.
Fixed cooking workbench not showing the kettle for new teas and added a dedicated craftable list with an “All” button and toggle‑group category navigation.

Added a second CaveNetworkGroupLayerOverride to the nuclear missile silo to stop players and NPCs disappearing on stairs, introduced DungeonGridBlocker to canyon tunnels to prevent unsafe underground train tunnels, and made all lighthouses share resource and repair progress for unified upkeep.
Fixed Frankenstein pet sinking in terrain, invisible ranged attacks, occasional kicking of the owner, and passing through windows.
Adjusted coconut tree spawn mechanics (range, 25% chance, removed spawns on certain palms) and increased apple and beehive spawn chances on oak trees.
Resolved artifacting on cargo map markers.
Fixed MeshCull reuse bug that caused code lock light indicators to render at any distance after spawning.

2026-10-19.summary:
### Crafting & Cooking
- Fixed cooking workbench not showing the kettle for new teas and added a dedicated craftable list with an “All” button and toggle‑group category navigation.

### Structures & World Safety
- Added a second CaveNetworkGroupLayerOverride to the nuclear missile silo to stop players and NPCs disappearing on stairs, introduced DungeonGridBlocker to canyon tunnels to prevent unsafe underground train tunnels, and made all lighthouses share resource and repair progress for unified upkeep.

### Pets & Companions
- Fixed Frankenstein pet sinking in terrain, invisible ranged attacks, occasional kicking of the owner, and passing through windows.

### Environment & Resources
- Adjusted coconut tree spawn mechanics (range, 25% chance, removed spawns on certain palms) and increased apple and beehive spawn chances on oak trees.

### Map & Navigation
- Resolved artifacting on cargo map markers.

### Security & Code Locks
- Fixed MeshCull reuse bug that caused code lock light indicators to render at any distance after spawning.

items.text: Headshot sound now matches the actual direction, fixing reversed left/right audio cues.
Seeds planted outside planters now display correct gene information in the UI.
Sheep can now be loaded onto small modules even when also leading a cow.

2026-10-18.summary:
### Combat Audio
- Headshot sound now matches the actual direction, fixing reversed left/right audio cues.

### Farming & UI
- Seeds planted outside planters now display correct gene information in the UI.

### Vehicle & Animal Transport
- Sheep can now be loaded onto small modules even when also leading a cow.

items.text: Fixed attached grenades staying invisible until the reveal animation event, so they now appear correctly when thrown or attached.

2026-10-16.summary:
### Combat & Explosives
- Fixed attached grenades staying invisible until the reveal animation event, so they now appear correctly when thrown or attached.
